meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会安装并初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的密钥搬进 Agent Vault 保管库并移除原密钥;然后重新构建、重启服务,让代理运行时由网关注入凭据。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 升级引入 OneCLI 破坏性变更之后,或首次需要搭建 OneCLI 时,适合让 Claude 运行这个技能。

say.text: 执行 init-onecli,把 .env 里的密钥迁进保管库。
say.note: 会先检查现状,再迁移并重启。

say.text: OneCLI 需要重新初始化,请重装并重新注册凭据。
say.note: 会走重装与重新注册的流程。

say.text: 跑一下 init-onecli,然后确认代理能否回复测试消息。
say.note: 完成后会让你发测试消息验证。

howto.what_en: It installs/initializes OneCLI, moves existing .env credentials into the Agent Vault, removes raw keys from .env, rebuilds and restarts the service. Credentials are then injected by the gateway.
howto.when_en: Use after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when setting up OneCLI from scratch.

say_en.text: Run init-onecli and move the .env credentials into the vault.
say_en.note: Checks current state, migrates, then restarts.

say_en.text: Reinitialize OneCLI from scratch and re-register credentials.
Run init-onecli, then verify by sending a test message.
say_en.note: After the run, asks you to test the agent.
